clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Orgrimmar, Oggleflint leads the trogg tribe in Ragefire Chasm. His pack climbs from lava-filled tunnels toward the surface, where he commands them near the cavern entrance and threatens the Horde capital above.

Deep beneath Orgrimmar, Oggleflint and his troggs climbed from fiery tunnels into Ragefire Chasm. They carved a primitive domain among the molten rock and defend it with brutal force. Troggs have little advanced civilization, and Oggleflint rules his pack through sheer strength.

Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem sent diplomats into the chasm to make peace with the troggs. The troggs turned on them and killed them. Maur Grimtotem, one of the envoys, lies dead in the caverns under Oggleflint’s watch. Near the cavern entrance, the chieftain waits and strikes at outsiders who venture into the dark.

Oggleflint’s tribe lives directly beneath Thrall’s capital, a hazard the Horde cannot tolerate. The troggs creep closer to the surface, and their volatile nature threatens to carry them into the Drag and Cleft of Shadow if left undisturbed.
